help.text1: Here you can listen to the created notations.
help.voiceControlText: You can turn voices on and off by clicking the button for the corresponding voice. Voices that are turned off are not displayed in the notation and are not played back.
help.voiceControlText2: By holding down the <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> key, you can hide a voice while keeping it audible during playback.
help.voiceOnNotVisible: The voice is turned on but not visible. It is audible during playback.
help.changeOutput: Change the audio output. You can choose between piano (default), synthesizer, violin, flute, and guitar.
help.playbackText: Playing back the notation. If you want to listen to the entire song or a shorter section several times in a row, (1) click the first note of the section, (2) hold down the <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> key, and (3) click the last note of the desired section. To exit repeat mode, click the reset arrow at the end of the selection.
help.adjustVolume: Adjust the overall playback pitch lower or higher.
help.adjustTempo: Adjust the playback tempo slower or faster.
help.switchMode: Switch between the simplified and detailed notation views. In the simplified view, the pitches of the staff lines and the up/down arrows (microtonality indicators) are not displayed.
help.displayEmbedding: Display the embed code for the notation. The code can be added to an external website (e.g. laul.setomaa.ee).
help.downloadPng: Download the notation as an image file (.png).
help.editorText: The editor allows you to experiment with creating notations.
help.voiceActivationText: When an active voice is selected, all subsequently added notes are assigned to that voice. All other voices are deactivated, meaning they are not audible during playback but remain faintly visible in the notation. Different voice combinations can be selected by holding down the <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> key.
help.voiceActiveNotVisible: The voice is not active, but the notes are fully visible and audible during playback.
help.voiceNotActive: The voice is not active; the notes are faintly visible and are not audible during playback.
help.changeScale: Change the staff. You can choose between the semitone–whole-and-a-half-tone (PPT), older diatonic, and newer diatonic scales. You can also create an entirely new staff. The staff can only be changed for a new notation.
help.addNote: Add a new note. In addition to using the mouse, you can enter notes using the number keys 1 to 6 or 7 on the keyboard, depending on the scale.
help.adjustPitch: Adjust the pitch of the selected note in cents.
help.toHalfNote: Change the selected note to a half note.
help.toQuarterNote: Change the selected note to a quarter note.
help.toEightNote: Change the selected note to an eighth note.
help.splitNote: Split the selected eighth note into two sixteenth notes.
help.adjustNoteSize: Change the size of the selected note. The first click makes the note smaller; the second restores its original size.
help.addSeparator: Add a separator. The first click adds a full-length separator, the second makes it shorter, and the third removes it.
help.shiftLyricsLeft: Shift the lyrics to the left. Requires holding down the <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> key.
help.shiftLyricsRight: Shift the lyrics to the right. Requires holding down the <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> key.
help.shiftVoicesLeft: Shift all notes and separators to the left. Requires holding down the <kbd>Shift</kbd> key.
help.shiftVoicesRight: Shift all notes and separators to the right. Requires holding down the <kbd>Shift</kbd> key.
help.reset: Delete the notation and start over.

home.title: Home
home.header: Seto leelo notation. A web application for learning Seto leelo melodies
home.description:
The application allows you to create and listen to Seto leelo notations using Seto notation.
The notation system is explained in more detail in <0>Leelokool (<1>laul.setomaa.ee/leelokool) on the <0>Seto Song Tradition website.
home.description2: The application includes audio recordings from the Estonian Folklore Archives of the Estonian Literary Museum and the folklore archives of the Finnish Literature Society.
